title: instantsearch.js overriding maxValuesPerFacet
body:
InstantSearch.js is overriding the maxValuesPerFacet to 10. PFB the same :-
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/8d4678c3583fbd59196cfcb80906264d10368208/src/widgets/refinement-list/refinement-list.js#L72:L84

So when business user decides to change this value through the Algolia Dashboard it doesn't work, since always the client code overrides the settings in the values set in Dashboard.

This should be removed from instantsearch.js and the business user should be able to adjust these values dynamically through the Algolia Dashboard.

Thanks,
Shinto
